name: iBorShell
description: iBorShell: a secure SSH terminal for DBX — interactive sessions, SFTP file transfer, multi-host exec, clone session and live server stats. Fork of jinpy's Terminal plugin.
releaseNotes: iBorShell 1.0.4: bug fix — the shell-integration install line (CWD tracking hook) could leak into the terminal as visible text when a loaded host was slow to reach its first prompt: the handshake filter's fail-open flush now scrubs the echoed install line before releasing buffered output, and the handshake window is widened from 3s to 8s. 1.0.3 changes carry over: history suggestions + inline ghost suggestions OFF by default (opt-in in Settings), live stats strip fresh collect every 15s and pauses while the Server metrics card is open. All platform packages are Ed25519-signed (key_id net.iborshell).
